metadata.oracle_evidence: solution/ replays the validated Sharpa Wave episode on the Marvin right arm (4,299 controls, success after 4,149: hose head pushed onto the valve and locked at control 306, 28 counted strokes to 210.64 kPa, lock opened and head pulled off at control 4,083, released hold); the standard oracle submits the same rows as float64 through the public client. Two fresh-process replays succeed with identical state hashes, and the rows rounded to float32 also succeed.

notes.layout: Each row starts with the 14 Marvin arm joint targets (left arm J1-J7, then right arm J1-J7), followed by the left hand's finger targets and then the right hand's (22 per hand for `sharpa`, 20 per hand for `wuji`); the left arm is parked and only the right arm/hand perform the task.
